tracks.theme: Mid-summer deep green - lush high meadows and blooming gardens, Sonamarg's glaciers cool, the Dal glass at dawn while the plains bake
tracks.subject: The valley is deep green, gardens in full bloom

tracks.theme: Peak Yatra-week rides and loss-aversion - airport runs, valley drives and golden-hour shikaras booking all day; an idle cab or boat loses the fare to a listed one
tracks.subject: Tonight's shikara just went to another boat

tracks.theme: Lakeside demand and loss-aversion - the Dal filling fast through the busy weeks; only listed boats get found, an unlisted deck loses tonight's guest
tracks.subject: Tonight's lake guest picked a listed boat, not yours
